title: deep-e2e-auditor finding (one JSON object per line in findings/<area>.jsonl)

id.description: AREA-N, e.g. BOARD-3, VIS-12. Unique within the run.

severity.description: S data loss/security/crash · A core feature broken · B visible bug or real UX defect · C minor/polish/edge · D nit

area.description: The area the agent covered (board, calendar, settings, checkout, …)

surface.description: Where it is seen: 'card context menu', 'Settings → Data', '/checkout @375px'

title.description: One line: what is wrong, not what to do

shots.description: Screenshot paths relative to the run dir

probe.description: The test/probe file that shows it

measure.description: A number: '1.9:1 contrast', '412 ms per keystroke', '11 chips on a 240px card'

boxes.description: Regions to box on screenshots (pixel coords in that image)

code_refs.description: file:line where the cause is, if found
